summary: Cybin Inc., operating as Helus Pharma, filed a Form 6-K containing a news release that its CEO, Michael Halstead, will participate in a fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 11, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of an upcoming investor conference appearance, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. The registrant's role is the issuer/filer. This is not a special situation; it is a standard corporate announcement with no deal terms or strategic implications that would classify under any special-situation category.
